product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud BIM and ISO 19650 management platform for AEC project teams to plan deliverables, assign responsibilities, manage documents and verify model/information delivery.
product_one_liner.notes: Described on company homepage and product help article.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation exposes a Pricing page; pricing information may require quotation.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in Plannerly's case-study directory.

hq_location.notes: Company profile lists Irvine, California as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn company profile states founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog is focused on BIM and ISO 19650 guides, product use, and marketing; it does not meet the threshold of two technical posts about how the software is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Public Help Center includes multiple product articles and collections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No company careers/job board page or currently open Plannerly-specific roles could be established from accessible search results.

model_provider.value: No specific AI model provider is disclosed for Plannerly's own product; Claude and ChatGPT are mentioned only as optional user-connected AI examples, not confirmed product providers.
model_provider.notes: The AI information page discusses AI usage and third-party tools without saying which provider powers Plannerly's AI functions.

compliance_certs.notes: Security page lists no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification. ISO 19650 references concern the BIM standard, not a security certification.

last_funding.notes: Search did not establish any Plannerly outside funding round or reliable funding history; an unrelated Tracxn funding snippet was not sufficient.

raised_18mo.notes: No verifiable funding history or dated round announcement was located.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No currently open Plannerly careers listing/job board was found to verify either openings or their absence.

launched_6mo.notes: A company video published about two months before the as-of date calls this the biggest release in Plannerly's history and describes new workflows/features.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A complete, current team page or reliable announcement/profile verifying leadership starts or departures during the period was not found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public help center was readable but names no CRM or sales/marketing system.
